findings.note: ESPN's fantasy column from Oct. 27, 2026 recommends streaming Frost this week. It says he plays on Calgary's top power-play unit with Farabee, where four of his seven points have come, though his even-strength ice time has been limited to 13:50 a night over his last three games.

An Oct. 11, 2026 RotoWire note says Frost scored two of Calgary's seven goals across its first five games, with a minus-6 rating. It calls Calgary's offense one to avoid but confirms he gets steady top-six and power-play minutes.

A Sept. 20, 2026 report says Frost opened camp as Calgary's No. 1 center after scoring 43 points in 82 games last season, which points to more ice time. It also warns he shouldn't be expected to provide high-end value on what is expected to be one of the NHL's weaker teams.
